name: trove-take-cut
description: Cut a raw multi-take recording down to one keeper per line. Use when the same lines were read several times and the retakes, stumbles, and dead air should go. Not for footage that is already a single take, and not for a single trim. Use when: cut out the bad takes; keep the last take of each line; remove the retakes from this recording; tighten the pauses in this read.
